title: Novelty Detection in Reinforcement Learning with World Models
summary: Major: Appendix D Eq7 infers Delta>=epsilon from Delta>=0 without a margin assumption; a coherent full-support binary model satisfies finite-error conditions yet violates Eqs4-5. Minor: universal AUC-comparison prose contradicts table entries. Approximation caveat and empirical successes preserved.
limitations: No author implementation located in staged sources; no execution.
Raw decisions, seeds, censoring rules and timing logs unavailable.
Exact-zero special case on p17 is not refuted by finite-epsilon example.

problems.title: Invalid epsilon-margin inference in central bound
problems.claim: Appendix D Eq7 derives a<=Delta from Delta>=0 and a<=epsilon.
assumptions: Coherent stationary conditional model with independent fair H,X and Z probabilities .8,.7,.8,.86; all local KLs<.01
problems.check: Exact 5(a-Delta)=log((79^4*21)/(75^4*25))>0; positive Delta does not reach epsilon.
problems.result: Finite-error implication false; central bound not derived from stated conditions.
problems.counterevidence: p17 explicitly labels approximation; exactly-zero special case and likelihood-ratio identity remain valid. Empirical utility not refuted.
problems.impact: Invalid derivation directly supports named core detector. No whole-paper collapse claimed.

correction.limits: Additional margin not implied by training or proven enforceable.

recovery_verification.check: Checked the full-support coherent binary conditional model, finite-error assumptions, exact positive margin violation, and h0 meaning. Appendix D Eq7 does not justify the core Eqs4-5 boundary. The exact-zero case, likelihood-ratio identity, approximation caveat and empirical scope are retained.

problems.title: Universal AUC comparison contradicted by table
problems.claim: Higher AUC than RIQN across all MiniGrid and Atari environments.
problems.location: p6 Sec4.3; Table5 p7 LavaGap; Table3 p6 Kangaroo FloorSwap
assumptions: Compare same reported row and higher-is-better AUC
problems.counterevidence: Many favorable entries and acknowledged DMC trade-offs survive.
problems.impact: Local comparative overstatement; no evidence tabulated data false.

correction.statement: Restrict comparative statement to supported environments or defined aggregates.

recovery_verification.check: Checked LavaGap .732 versus .760 and Kangaroo .281 versus .541 against the universal comparative sentence. The Minor correction concerns that wording; favorable table entries and empirical trade-offs remain.

unresolved_items.reason: Reported AUC uses raw a, not adaptive margin a-Delta; raw paired arrays unavailable.
Censoring, FP denominator, seeds/timing logs and implementation not available.

repair_verification: Adding Delta>=epsilon suffices algebraically for the finite-error implication; this extra assumption is not derived from training and does not validate detector calibration.
